detections.original: HNGH... HAA...
detections.translated: HNGH... HAA...

detections.original: OHO, YOU'RE STILL CONSCIOUS AFTER THAT?
detections.translated: Oho, tu es encore conscient après ça ?

detections.original: EVEN OUR OWNEMPLOYEES CAN'T TAKE ABLOW LIKE THAT.
detections.translated: Même nos propres employés ne peuvent pas encaisser un coup pareil.

detections.original: BUT WHILE I'D LOVE TO PLAY ABIT MORE WITH YOU...
detections.translated: Mais même si j'adorerais jouer un peu plus avec toi...

detections.original: ..IDON'T HAVE MUCH TIME.
detections.translated: ...je n'ai pas beaucoup de temps.

detections.original: OH, BUT DON'T WORRY.
detections.translated: Oh, mais ne t'inquiète pas.

detections.original: I'M NOT GONNA KILL YOU WITH THIS.
detections.translated: Je ne vais pas te tuer avec ça.

detections.original: WE NEED TO BRING YOU IN ALIVE.
detections.translated: Nous devons te ramener vivant.

detections.original: JUST SIT STILL AND YOU WON'T GET CUT.
detections.translated: Reste tranquille et tu ne seras pas coupé.

detections.original: BUT SEE, THE VIP HAS. PECULIAR TASTES.
detections.translated: Mais tu vois, le VIP a des goûts particuliers.

detections.original: HE WANTS TO SEE YOUR EXPRESSIONWHEN THISLADY DIES.
detections.translated: Il veut voir ton expression quand cette femme mourra.

detections.original: …WHAT?
detections.translated: ...Quoi ?

detections.original: SHE MIGHT BLEEDOUTSOON ANY WAY.
detections.translated: Elle pourrait de toute façon se vider de son sang bientôt.

detections.original: THAT LOOKS LIKE IT HURTS...
detections.translated: Ça a l'air de faire mal...

detections.original: I'LL MAKE THE PAIN STOP FOR YOU.
detections.translated: Je vais faire cesser la douleur pour toi.

detections.original: NO...
detections.translated: Non...

detections.original: STOP...
detections.translated: Arrête...

detections.original: YES, THAT'S THE FACE I WANTED TO SEE!!!
detections.translated: Oui, c'est le visage que je voulais voir !!!

detections.original: HUH?
detections.translated: HEIN ?

detections.original: THIS ISN'T ANY FUN.
detections.translated: Ce n'est plus amusant.

detections.original: YOU'RE STARTING TO ANNOY ME...
detections.translated: Tu commences à m'énerver...

detections.original: IT OLD YOU I'D KEEP YOU ALIVE IF YOU JUST STAYED STILL!
detections.translated: Je t'ai dit que je te garderais en vie si tu restais immobile !

detections.original: WHO THE F*** DO YOU THINK YOU ARE TOBUTT IN?!
detections.translated: Qui diable crois-tu être pour t'immiscer ?!

detections.original: WEAKLINGS LIKE YOU SHOULD JUST STAY IN THE F***INGCORNER!
detections.translated: Les faibles comme toi devraient juste rester dans leur putain de coin !

detections.original: HAA... HAA...
detections.translated: HAA... HAA...

detections.original: YOU'VE GONE ANDPISSEDMEOFF FOR REAL NOW.
detections.translated: Tu m'as vraiment énervé maintenant.

detections.original: I WAS GOING TO HANDLE THIS NICELY, BUT THAT'S OFF THE TABLE NOW.
detections.translated: J'allais gérer ça gentiment, mais ce n'est plus d'actualité.

detections.original: YOU BROUGHT THIS
detections.translated: Tu as provoqué ça.

detections.original: AN AXE?
detections.translated: Une hache ?

detections.original: KIDS THESE DAYS ARE ALL SO PERVERTED,EH?

detections.original: LEAVE THEM ALONE AND SCRAM BACK TO YOUR CHAIRMAN JIN.
detections.translated: Laissez-les tranquilles et retournez auprès de votre Président Jin.
